rules.text: The hook must never break the agent. Every hook path exits 0, bounds its own time, and writes nothing to stdout but the JSON the host expects.

criteria.false: catch (error) { log.debug(error); return ok(); } and a single JSON.stringify to stdout

rules.text: Never accept it as a flag — a flag lands in shell history and in CI logs.

rules.text: Closed sets use an exhaustive `switch` + `assertNever`. Never use if/else-if chains for mutually-exclusive variants.

question.instructions: This change branches on the discriminant of a union or enum. Which shape does it use?

criteria.none: no branching on a discriminant or enum here
criteria.switch-assertnever: a switch ending in default: return assertNever(value)
criteria.switch-no-assertnever: a switch with no default, or a default that does not call assertNever
criteria.if-else-chain: if / else if over the discriminant, or a ternary chain

rules.text: When behavior depends on several related status checks, derive one closed decision/status type and switch over that — don't scatter conditionals through a method.

question.instructions: Does this change decide one outcome from several related boolean or status checks spread through a function, instead of deriving one closed status value and switching over it?

criteria.false: const verdict = toVerdict(stats); switch (verdict) { ... }

rules.text: Use `type`, not `interface`.
